title: Malaysia Stock Market May Test Support At 1,700 Points
text:
Malaysia Stock Market May Test Support At 1,700 Points November 04, 2018, 06:30: Malaysia stock market moved higher again on Friday, one day after it had ended the three-day winning streak in which it had gathered more than 25 points or 1.5 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now rests just beneath the 1,715-point plateau although it's likely to head south again KLCI finished modestly higher on Friday as gains from the plantations and telecoms were tempered by weakness from the financial shares.
For the day, the index picked up 6.95 points or 0.41 percent to finish at 1,713.87 after trading between 1,705.31 and 1,720.13. Volume was 3.1 billion shares worth 2.5 billion ringgit. There were 744 gainers and 204 decliners.
Among the actives, Sime Darby surged 5.26 percent, while Genting plummeted 2.70 percent, IOI Corporation soared 1.34 percent, Petronas Chemicals spiked 1.28 percent, Digi.com jumped 1.18 percent, Tenaga Nasional climbed 0.96 percent, IHH Healthcare skidded 0.80 percent, Dialog Group advanced 0.60 percent, Telekom Malaysia gathered 0.42 percent, CIMB Group fell 0.35 percent, Kuala Lumpur Kepong slid 0.32 percent, Axiata lost 0.29 percent, Genting Malaysia added 0.22 percent and Maybank was unchanged.
 (AAPL)
Closer to home, Malaysia will release September numbers for imports, exports and trade balance later today. In August, imports were worth 80.2 billion ringgit and exports were at 81.8 billion ringgit for a trade surplus of 1.6 billion ringgit. //www.rttnews.com/2951202/malaysia-stock-market-may-test-support-at-1700-points.aspx This article appears in: World Markets , US Markets , Stocks More from RTT News
